title: salvia pratensis var. albiflora
intro: Salvia pratensis var. albiflora, commonly known as white meadow clary or white meadow sage, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, thanks to its therapeutic actions as a nervine and anxiolytic. The bioactive constituents of Salvia pratensis var. albiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's bioactive compounds may interact with the body's natural systems to promote relaxation and reduce stress, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting a good night's sleep and calming the mind.
